Exit `75` is the explicit approval pause, not an error or permission to continue. Resume in a fresh fenced shell only after the user approves the exact rotation-plan hash; re-resolve the active immutable verifier, content-addressed plan, terminalization condition, and approval roots rather than retaining shell variables.

```bash
set -euo pipefail
active_pointer=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime/active-home23-release.json
runtime_authority=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime
release_parent=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23-code-releases/worker-runtime

json_raw() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$2" raw -o - "$1"; }
sha256_file() { /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'; }
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' "$1")" = "$(/usr/bin/id -u)"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1
  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}

  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

```bash
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' "$1")" = "$(/usr/bin/id -u)"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1
  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

The one transactional, restart-resumable finalizer is the only writer in this step. It derives the short/medium due times from the immutable cleanup policy, closes and replay-denies the exact authorization, registers exactly one obligation, releases the broad mutation fence, and retains the payment/deploy block. It is idempotent after every persisted suffix. Expected: `closed` plus replay denial and one obligation; no credential, payment method, direct email, or session value appears in the canonical receipt.

- [ ] **Step 11: Wait for and complete the short and medium read-only settlement obligations**

The due times are fixed by the immutable cleanup policy and persisted before fence release; they are not arbitrary sleeps and survive process restart. The dedicated non-model-visible settlement observer from Tasks 8/18—not the operator CLI or this verifier—claims each due row, invokes only the typed GET-shaped settlement capability, persists its authoritative evidence, and releases the block after both rows complete. At each due time it re-reads the exact Checkout Session, Subscription, Invoice, PaymentIntent, Charge, Refund and balance transactions, webhook ledger, profile, entitlement, upcoming invoice state, PaymentMethod attachment state, and authorization replay decision. It replays fixture copies of delayed, duplicate, and out-of-order webhook deliveries only against an isolated temporary handler/data root; production webhook injection is forbidden. Require no entitlement reactivation, provider mutation/effect row, second refund/cancel/detach, renewal, or net-cost drift. A late real webhook already durably received must converge through the deployed idempotent handler and still satisfy those invariants.

```bash
sha256_file() { /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'; }
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"

  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {

  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")

}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Prove restart and reconstruction persistence after all live work**

Resolve the active immutable `HOME23_CODE_ROOT` only through the protected pointer and its exact committed `deploymentJournalId`; never infer it from the prepared manifest or mutable implementation worktree. Recompute the payload hash/non-writability, then bind the restart executable's file SHA, the canonical fixed-argv SHA, and the domain-separated command SHA as three distinct fields. Invoke exactly the manifest's fixed `restart-continuity --from-active-manifest` argv through the manifest-pinned Node executable—no hardcoded path, process list, extra flag, or shell evaluation. The restart module re-reads the same pointer/journal/manifest chain before rolling only the six immutable owner/harness/engine/dashboard definitions. Prove a queued request survives, ShakedownJerry state and attempt history reconstruct, the active standing grant and closed hard stops persist, the completed automation-cutover journal and payment settlement completion persist, all four next wakes reconstruct, pursuit/outbox history remains exact, and zero Worker/Shakedown process or port is added. Fresh topology readback must show zero unexpected PM2/launchd processes, exactly one `jerry-api` process owning both `127.0.0.1:3005` and `127.0.0.1:3006`, no wildcard listener on either port, and no Caddy upstream targeting port 3006.

```bash
set -euo pipefail
active_pointer=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime/active-home23-release.json
runtime_authority=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime
release_parent=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23-code-releases/worker-runtime

json_raw() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$2" raw -o - "$1"; }
sha256_file() { /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'; }
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' "$1")" = "$(/usr/bin/id -u)"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1
  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

Observe the next naturally due mapped occurrences after Step 2. Require enqueue, claim, one attempt, one canonical receipt, real scan and collection/enrichment consequences, pursuit attachment, Worker Desk/Jerry projection, and advanced next wakes. The two legacy product automations remain paused throughout; no dual delivery or cross-runtime dedupe claim is needed.

```bash
set -euo pipefail
active_pointer=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime/active-home23-release.json
runtime_authority=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime
release_parent=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23-code-releases/worker-runtime

json_raw() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$2" raw -o - "$1"; }
sha256_file() { /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'; }
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' "$1")" = "$(/usr/bin/id -u)"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1
  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Prove recovery instructions are executable without applying them on a healthy cutover**

Read the cutover's inverse operations and verify their preconditions against current authoritative state. For a schedule whose Task 31 prior state was absent, the canonical inverse operation is `remove-new-worker-schedule` with a required current-definition-hash precondition; otherwise it is `restore-worker-schedule` with the exact prior definition. The journal retains each legacy Codex automation's complete prior definition as historical evidence, but the recovery-plan projection is phase-aware: after stable-data commit, every operation that could re-enable a legacy writer is marked ineligible and omitted from executable output, which may restore only the prior replacement epoch or keep both ingress families paused. Because the product has no compare-and-swap, eligible recovery is explicitly: disable/remove replacement schedule first, fresh-read product definition, require the intended hash, update the exact ID with every eligible prior field, authoritative readback, append transition, then `mark-rolled-back`. Do not execute these inverses while Step 1–3 state is healthy.

```bash
set -euo pipefail
active_pointer=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime/active-home23-release.json
runtime_authority=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23/instances/workers/runtime
release_parent=/Users/jtr/_JTR23_/release/home23-code-releases/worker-runtime

json_raw() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$2" raw -o - "$1"; }
sha256_file() { /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'; }
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' "$1")" = "$(/usr/bin/id -u)"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1
  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

```bash
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1

home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then

          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}

    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then
          tree_target=$(/usr/bin/readlink "$tree_path")
          tree_resolved=$(/bin/realpath "$tree_path")
          case "$tree_resolved" in "$tree_root"/*) ;; *) exit 91 ;; esac
          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then
          tree_file_sha=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$tree_path" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
          /usr/bin/printf 'f\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_file_sha"
        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Route each failing boundary to one owner under only its relevant fence**

Do not flatten a Task 33 failure into a global automation rollback. Every non-passing Step 1–7 command emits its normal canonical evidence plus a mode-`0400`, content-addressed `home23.task33-failure.v1` orchestration receipt beneath the fixed Worker receipt root. The receipt binds the current deployment journal ID and release-manifest hash, exact failing evidence path/hash, closed boundary, and closed owner route. `TASK33_FAILURE_RECEIPT` supplies only that receipt's path; the shell validates the root, filename/content hash, mode, current deployment binding, failing evidence hash, and exact boundary/owner pair before selection. A stale, mutable, cross-release, unknown, or caller-invented value cannot enter a branch. Branch selection itself grants no authority, and every branch re-reads its own authoritative state through the authenticated service. The closed routing is:

- Step 1 automation/matrix drift -> Tasks 27 and 31 Step 12. Fence only automation/schedule ingress and use the cutover journal. An exact known cutover may enter `begin-rollback` and apply the branded local rows. If the operations receipt names eligible Codex automation product rows, the executing Codex agent—not Home23, the Worker, or either verifier—fresh-reads each exact product ID through the automation product tool, checks the intended hash, applies the full recorded definition, reads it back, and supplies that readback to the second half of Task 31 Step 12. Unknown/mixed state remains `reconciliation_required` under that same narrow fence.
- Step 2 active-pointer, deployment-journal, manifest, tree, restart, or process-identity failure -> Task 29 only. If the literal bootstrap fails, execute no release byte; the Task 29 deployment journal's already-installed owner-harness startup reconciler elects one recovery writer and retains only the affected deployment-target fence. Never start a cutover rollback for a broken code pointer or restart.
- Step 2 payment-settlement reconstruction failure -> Tasks 5, 8, and 32. Keep the existing payment/backend/site deployment block; let the dedicated settlement observer claim or reconcile the due observation. Do not add a cutover fence, close a second authorization, or perform an operator settlement mutation.
- Step 3 next-wake/occurrence failure -> Tasks 11 and 13. Fence only the two affected schedule IDs/occurrence keys and preserve the other Worker lanes.
- Step 4 recovery-plan or grant/cutover projection failure -> Tasks 5 and 10. Revoke the exact standing grant and fence only recovery/schedule mutation while the cutover projection is reconciled; healthy site, data, payment-observer, and read-only lanes remain available.
- Steps 5–7 explanation, receipt projection, completion writer, or strict-verifier failure -> Tasks 9, 10, or 28 according to the failing route. These are read/projection failures and acquire no consequence fence unless their fresh receipt identifies one of the concrete state drifts above, in which case reclassify to that branch. Never write the final completion receipt after any such failure.

Only the automation branch may continue into the cutover rollback protocol. Its first half below performs local branded recovery only and deliberately stops before any external product mutation. The Codex automation product-tool readback and authenticated append/reconcile/`mark-rolled-back` sequence are the explicit second half in Task 31 Step 12. After the owner-specific durable handoff, add the failing regression in that owning task, rerun Task 28, redeploy through Task 29 if code changed, rebind Task 30 if the grant hash changed, repeat the affected Task 31/32 proof, and restart Task 33 at Step 1. This recovery router itself never edits source, matrix, or live product definitions.

```bash
json_raw() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$2" raw -o - "$1"; }
sha256_file() { /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'; }
require_owned_mode() {
  test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' "$1")" = "$(/usr/bin/id -u)"
  test "$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" = "$2"
}
require_safe_relative_file() {
  relative_path=$1
  case "$relative_path" in ''|/*|*//*|./*|*/./*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) return 1 ;; esac
  resolved_path=$(/bin/realpath "$active_code_root/$relative_path")
  case "$resolved_path" in "$active_code_root"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  test -f "$resolved_path" && test ! -L "$resolved_path"
  printf '%s\n' "$resolved_path"
}
home23_tree_hash() {
  tree_root=$1
  (
    cd "$tree_root"
    LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/find . -mindepth 1 -print | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort |
      while IFS= read -r tree_path; do
        tree_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$tree_path")
        if test -L "$tree_path"; then

          /usr/bin/printf 'l\0%s\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path" "$tree_target"
        elif test -f "$tree_path"; then

        elif test -d "$tree_path"; then
          /usr/bin/printf 'd\0%s\0%s\0' "$tree_mode" "$tree_path"
        else
          exit 92
        fi
      done
  ) | /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'
}

test -f "$failing_evidence" && test ! -L "$failing_evidence"
test "$(sha256_file "$failing_evidence")" = "$failing_evidence_sha256"
failed_boundary=$(json_raw "$task33_failure_receipt" boundary)
failure_owner=$(json_raw "$task33_failure_receipt" ownerRoute)
case "$failed_boundary:$failure_owner" in
  automation-matrix-drift:task27-cutover)
    epoch_context=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover show shakedown-jerry \
      --context-receipt-path-only --service-url "$service_url" \
      --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management --credential-account operator)
    cutover_id=$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract cutoverId raw -o - "$epoch_context")
    automation_fence_receipt=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker maintenance-fence acquire shakedown-jerry \
      --subject "task33:automation-recovery:$cutover_id" \
      --owning-action-class automation-cutover-recovery \
      --owning-operation-id "$cutover_id:task33-drift" \
      --blocked-class automation --blocked-class schedule --wait-for-drain --receipt-path-only \
      --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
      --credential-account operator)
    recovery_phase=$("$node_executable" "$shakedown_verifier" \
      --mode deployment-epoch-failure-recovery --cutover-id "$cutover_id" \
      --fsync-failure --classify-authoritative-phase --print-phase)
    case "$recovery_phase" in
      exact-known-before-stable-data-commit|exact-known-at-or-after-stable-data-commit)
        authoritative_state_hash=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover show shakedown-jerry \
          --cutover-id "$cutover_id" --authoritative-state-hash-only \
          --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
          --credential-account operator)
        rollback_operations=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover begin-rollback shakedown-jerry \
          --cutover-id "$cutover_id" --authoritative-state-hash "$authoritative_state_hash" \
          --operations-receipt-path-only --service-url "$service_url" \
          --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management --credential-account operator)
        local_recovery_receipt=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover apply-local-recovery shakedown-jerry \
          --cutover-id "$cutover_id" --operations-receipt "$rollback_operations" \
          --local-operations-only --receipt-path-only --service-url "$service_url" \
          --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management --credential-account operator)
        printf 'cutover=%s\noperations=%s\nlocal=%s\nfence=%s\n' \
          "$cutover_id" "$rollback_operations" "$local_recovery_receipt" "$automation_fence_receipt"
        exit 75
        ;;
      unknown-or-mixed)
        "$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover reconcile shakedown-jerry \
          --cutover-id "$cutover_id" --fresh-authoritative-state \
          --require-status reconciliation_required --require-authoritative-readbacks \
          --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
          --credential-account operator
        ;;
      *) exit 1 ;;
    esac
    ;;
  active-pointer-or-restart:task29-deployment)
    "$node_executable" "$restart_script" reconcile \
      --require-no-open-deployment --fail-on-frozen-target
    exit 76
    ;;
  payment-settlement:task5-8-32-settlement)
    settlement_context=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker payment-settlement show shakedown-jerry \
      --context-receipt-path-only --require-open-or-complete \
      --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
      --credential-account operator)
    settlement_status=$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract status raw -o - "$settlement_context")
    if test "$settlement_status" != complete; then
      test "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract deploymentBlockState raw -o - "$settlement_context")" = active
    fi
    exit 77
    ;;
  scheduler-occurrence:task11-13-scheduler)
    epoch_context=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover show shakedown-jerry \
      --context-receipt-path-only --service-url "$service_url" \
      --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management --credential-account operator)
    cutover_id=$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract cutoverId raw -o - "$epoch_context")
    "$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker maintenance-fence acquire shakedown-jerry \
      --subject "task33:scheduler-recovery:$cutover_id" \
      --owning-action-class scheduler-occurrence-recovery \
      --owning-operation-id "$cutover_id:post-restart-wakes" \
      --blocked-class schedule --wait-for-drain --receipt-path-only \
      --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
      --credential-account operator
    exit 78
    ;;
  recovery-plan:task5-10-authority)
    epoch_context=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker automation-cutover show shakedown-jerry \
      --context-receipt-path-only --service-url "$service_url" \
      --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management --credential-account operator)
    cutover_id=$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract cutoverId raw -o - "$epoch_context")
    grant_hash=$("$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker grant show shakedown-jerry \
      --canonical-hash-only --service-url "$service_url" \
      --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management --credential-account operator)
    "$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker maintenance-fence acquire shakedown-jerry \
      --subject "task33:recovery-plan:$cutover_id" \
      --owning-action-class recovery-plan-reconciliation \
      --owning-operation-id "$cutover_id:recovery-plan" \
      --blocked-class recovery --blocked-class schedule --wait-for-drain --receipt-path-only \
      --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
      --credential-account operator
    "$node_executable" "$home23_cli" worker grant revoke shakedown-jerry \
      --grant-hash "$grant_hash" \
      --service-url "$service_url" --credential-keychain-service home23.worker-management \
      --credential-account operator
    exit 79
    ;;
  explanation-or-projection:task9-10-28-projection)
    printf '%s\n' 'No consequence fence: retain the failing canonical receipt and return to Task 9, 10, or 28.'
    exit 80
    ;;
  *) exit 1 ;;
esac
```

Expected: exactly one owner route is selected. Only automation drift enters cutover rollback; pointer/restart recovery remains in the Task 29 deployment journal, payment obligations retain their existing observer/deployment block, wake failures fence only the affected scheduler lane, recovery-plan mismatch revokes the exact grant and fences only recovery/schedule mutation, and explanation/projection failures cause no production mutation.

## Completion Gate

- [ ] Every Worker manifest field has tested runtime meaning, every dispatch surface uses the canonical queue/client, and existing workers remain live-proven.
- [ ] ShakedownJerry is one Jerry-owned lightweight worker with no separate engine, brain, dashboard, scheduler daemon, or PM2 family.
- [ ] The exact signed standing grant is active, revocable, enforced at the action boundary, and no alternate tool/shell/browser/file path bypasses it.
- [ ] Site, code, collection, enrichment, distribution, communications, campaign, indexing, social-image, recovery, and conversion lanes each have fresh consequence and rollback/readback receipts.
- [ ] The production signup/payment/webhook/entitlement canary completed under its separate exact authorization and its authorized cleanup is verified.
- [ ] The operator checkout, shared `dist`, `html/pro`, `env-config.js`, `v2.shakedownshuffle.com`, user data, billing state outside the canary, and unrelated runtimes are unchanged except where a receipt explicitly proves an authorized mutation.
- [ ] Replacement schedules passed disabled shadow/restart proof; legacy consequential ingresses were then paused before replacements were enabled, controlled and naturally due consequences executed exactly once, and full-definition recovery operations remain verified.
- [ ] Jerry can truthfully explain the current worker, evidence, actions, consequences, learning, next work, and rollback/revocation controls.
